# SEC Postgraduate Scholarships

The **H. Boyd McWhorter Scholar-Athletes of the Year** is the highest academic honor presented by the Southeastern Conference. Established in 1986, the award recognizes the league’s top male and female scholar-athletes each year. The two winners receive a $20,000 scholarship to pursue their postgraduate studies, while all campus nominees earn a $10,000 scholarship in recognition of their academic excellence and athletic achievement.

The **Brad Davis SEC Community Service Postgraduate Scholarship** honors the legacy of former Associate Commissioner Brad Davis, who served the conference from 1988 until his passing in 2006. This award celebrates student-athletes who demonstrate exceptional commitment to community service and leadership. Each SEC university selects a male and female nominee, with the two overall winners receiving a $15,000 postgraduate scholarship. All other campus nominees are awarded a $7,500 scholarship, provided by the SEC.

# SEC Postgraduate Scholarships

The **H. Boyd McWhorter Scholar-Athletes of the Year** is the highest academic honor presented by the Southeastern Conference. Established in 1986, the award recognizes the league’s top male and female scholar-athletes each year. The two winners receive a $20,000 scholarship to pursue their postgraduate studies, while all campus nominees earn a $10,000 scholarship in recognition of their academic excellence and athletic achievement.

The **Brad Davis SEC Community Service Postgraduate Scholarship** honors the legacy of former Associate Commissioner Brad Davis, who served the conference from 1988 until his passing in 2006. This award celebrates student-athletes who demonstrate exceptional commitment to community service and leadership. Each SEC university selects a male and female nominee, with the two overall winners receiving a $15,000 postgraduate scholarship. All other campus nominees are awarded a $7,500 scholarship, provided by the SEC.

This is a **list of Rhodes Scholars**, covering _notable_ people who have received a [Rhodes Scholarship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhodes_Scholarship "Rhodes Scholarship") to the [University of Oxford](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Oxford "University of Oxford") since its 1902 founding, sorted by the year the scholarship started and student surname. All names are verified using the [Rhodes Scholar Database](https://www.rhodeshouse.ox.ac.uk/scholars-alumni/rhodes-scholar-database/). This is _not_ an exhaustive list of all Rhodes Scholars.

This is a **list of Rhodes Scholars**, covering _notable_ people who have received a [Rhodes Scholarship](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rhodes_Scholarship "Rhodes Scholarship") to the [University of Oxford](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/University_of_Oxford "University of Oxford") since its 1902 founding, sorted by the year the scholarship started and student surname. All names are verified using the [Rhodes Scholar Database](https://www.rhodeshouse.ox.ac.uk/scholars-alumni/rhodes-scholar-database/). This is _not_ an exhaustive list of all Rhodes Scholars.

# Rhodes Scholar Database
